_comment: Mechanism C's meter registry. Two campaigns, one per containment variant (C1 = docker --internal network + dual-homed proxy; C2 = docker --network none + unix-socket relay). listen_host is 0.0.0.0 because the metering proxy is a container here and its only clients arrive over a container network / a published loopback port, not from a process on the same host. The token is the meter's optional second attribution check (INTERFACE.md S8); codex carries it as a provider http_header so the check is exercised, not merely declared.
